definition: σχολή, -ῆς, ἡ  [in LXX: Gen.33:14 (κατὰ σ., אַט), Pro.28:19, Sir.38:24 * ;] __1. leisure.  __2. Later (from Plato on),  __(a) that for which leisure is employed, a disputation, lecture;  __(b) the place where lectures are delivered, a school: Act.19:9 (for the later sense of employment, see MM, xxiv).† (AS)
